mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, user_id, total_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, total_quantity, status, remark, receiver, phone, address_detail, buyer_longitude, buyer_latitude, shop_id, shop_name, shop_longitude, shop_latitude, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{totalQuantity}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{addressDetail}, #{buyerLongitude}, #{buyerLatitude}, #{shopId}, #{shopName}, #{shopLongitude}, #{shopLatitude}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, pay_type = #{payType}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, receive_time = #{receiveTime}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3 AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND create_time < #{timeoutTime}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 2 AND deleted = 0 AND rider_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET rider_id = #{riderId}, rider_name = #{riderName}, rider_phone = #{riderPhone}, rider_take_time = #{riderTakeTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND rider_id IS NULL AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND rider_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE rider_id = #{riderId} AND deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY create_time DESC
